bio.text: Nicole Cannizzaro, a Democrat, has represented District 6 in the Nevada Senate since 2016 and has been Senate Majority Leader since March 2019.
She is the Democratic candidate for Nevada attorney general in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She holds a business degree from the University of Nevada, Reno and a law degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, William S. Boyd School of Law, and was born in Las Vegas.
Before the Senate she worked in the Clark County District Attorney's office, which she joined in 2011, according to Ballotpedia.
